sourceNotes.rawContent: Add a touch of mystical charm to your look with this sparkling Evil Eye bracelet. Designed for effortless daily styling, this high-fashion piece shines brightest when kept away from water and perfumes. Store in a dry place after each wear to preserve its radiant silver-toned finish.
